Thank You
summary:
Hello Everyone,
Me Enakshi Das and my teammate,Srijita Panja created Lumatrace, a public facing web that enables an user to input astronomical data and their coordinates of any particular space object and would be able to view the images over the years to compare them and study their motion.
We credit NASA IPAC IRSA SPHERE x WISE data , ESA Gaia data and Canadian space agency databases for being essential resources provided by NASA to help us build our project.
details: Our tool helps anyone who uses to view astronomical objects over years to compare their motion and study about their properties.
